method: dynamic: the model's interim thermal law for a point site (the law the engine applies to the monitor PDs, the die sensor and every aggressor path): each source s adds a lag with residue c(d) Z0 and one pole tau_xt(d) at the node's distance d, c(d) = clip(0.03 x 60 um / d, 0.015, 1). Lags stepped by mrm.plant.thermal.thermal_step_b from the reset state with the source powers the engine used (heaters, absorbed light, junction and driver heat, aggressor), read every 10 us (aggressor: linear in between, as the engine's waveform; the other sources: held at the value read at the end of each interval, as the engine holds them per tick). steady state of the reset inputs (settled start; the engine's settled lags are within 0.28 mK of it)

observers.note: ring_rise_k / heater_rise_k / pd_rise_k / die0_rise_k: the engine's own observers at t_s (ring = mode-weighted ring temperature, heater = heater resistor). map_at_*: the map's law at the exact ring centre and PD position. The map equals the engine at the PDs (same law); at a ring it does not: the ring is its own lumped observer (self path with three poles, light heats it 1.76 x more per mW than the heater), which the point law does not contain. Draw the rings with ring_rise_k.

display_hint_k.note: the law is clipped at c = 1 below 1.8 um and peaks at point sources (the aggressor site, drivers): clip the colour scale (p99 or the ring maximum)
